concerns.text: FR-006 requires fitting a Repeated‑Measures ANOVA on pass@1 and pass@10 outcomes, which are binary (pass@1) or proportion (pass@10) data. Standard ANOVA assumes continuous, normally‑distributed residuals; applying it to binary outcomes violates these assumptions and can lead to invalid significance tests. The specification should instead use a generalized linear mixed model (e.g., logistic GLMM for pass@1) or a non‑parametric alternative appropriate for binary/proportion data.
